title: Canopy leak at night 80 miles from the carrier
place_text: About 80 miles west of the aircraft carrier, 30,000 ft

tellings.quote: I was about 80 miles west of the boat, 30,000 feet or so, um, nighttime, and all of a sudden my canopy starts leaking.

plain: A Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says that one night, flying about 30,000 feet up and around 80 miles west of his aircraft carrier, his canopy, the clear bubble over the cockpit, suddenly started leaking. He tells it as an example of the real dangers pilots face on routine flights.
